description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity to join a dedicated team committed to providing exceptional patient care and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader passionate about making a significant impact on the lives of residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive, supportive environment. Your leadership will drive continuous improvement in quality of care, resident satisfaction, and financial performance.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with your experience and qualifications. If you are a dynamic leader ready for a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility setting
Strong leadership, management, and communication skills
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are urgently seeking an experienced Regional Director of Operations to join a premier skilled nursing facility.
